description: This Dart file defines the 'DashboardScreen' Flutter widget for the frontend UI of a dashboard app. It includes layout, styling, and multiple widget components such as header, hero promo, feature tiles, poster cards, and navigation bar.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main StatefulWidget representing the dashboard screen with various UI components.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing layout, theme colors, and UI state, such as selected navigation index.

classes.name: _HeaderRow
classes.description: Widget for displaying the header section with welcome text and icon buttons.

classes.name: _HeaderTextBlock
classes.description: Widget displaying the welcome messages and account info text.

classes.name: _CircleOutlineIconButton
classes.description: Reusable circular icon button with outline border for actions like search and notifications.

classes.name: _HeroPromoCard
classes.description: Widget for displaying the promotional hero section with gradient background, titles, button, and custom painter overlays.

classes.name: _HeroXGlowPainter
classes.description: CustomPainter for drawing animated X glow effects on the hero promo card.

classes.name: _SectionTitle
classes.description: Widget displaying section titles such as 'Featured' and 'Curated for you'.

classes.name: _FeaturedTilesRow
classes.description: Row widget containing multiple feature tiles for quick actions.

classes.name: _FeaturedTile
classes.description: Individual tile widget with icon and label, styled according to design spec.

classes.name: _CuratedHorizontalList
classes.description: Horizontal list view for displaying poster cards.

classes.name: _PosterCard
classes.description: Decorative poster card with gradient background, border, overlay button, and optional 'X' overlay.

classes.name: _BottomNavBar
classes.description: Bottom navigation bar widget with four icons, handling selection state.

classes.name: _BottomNavIconsRow
classes.description: Placeholder widget (unused) intended for the icons row inside the nav bar.

classes.name: _NavIcon
classes.description: Individual icon button for navigation, indicating active/inactive state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main scaffold, setting background, body content, and bottom navigation with state management.
